📅 Contract Duration: 4 Weeks
⏰ Availability: 8 hours/day with 4 hours PST overlap

Strong experience in Advanced Python programming.

Hands-on experience building production-grade AI agents and multi-step agentic systems.

Databricks Partner Champion | Remote Contract
We are hiring for a client. Vextara Info Systems Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a Databricks Partner Champion to lead strategic customer engagements, guide complex implementations and grow a Databricks Centre of Excellence (CoE).
📍 Remote | Contract | 2 openings
💼 8+ years in Data & AI or Data Engineering
🗓️ Immediate / ASAP start
🕒 Working hours · 2:30 PM–11:30 PM (time zone to be confirmed)
Active Databricks Partner Champion status is mandatory. Applicants must have successfully completed the Partner Champion panel process and already hold active status.
Required experience
Delivering Databricks implementations for customers and advising on architecture, platform adoption and modernisation
Contributing to Databricks Centres of Excellence and community initiatives
Building strong relationships within the Databricks ecosystem
Mentoring and developing technical teams
Hands-on expertise in at least one area
Databricks Lakehouse architecture, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, data engineering and architecture, machine learning and generative AI, analytics engineering, data platform modernisation, or cloud data platforms.
What you’ll do
Set Databricks architecture and delivery standards, review solution designs and support complex implementations and technical escalations. Lead CoE development, mentor future Partner Champions and work with Databricks alliance, account and field teams on strategic pursuits. Share expertise through customer workshops, executive briefings, technical articles, industry events and reusable assets.
📩 Send your updated resume to careers@vextarainfo.com with the subject Databricks Partner Champion | Remote. Please mention your active Partner Champion status and earliest start date.
